Remarks (FY 2019-2020):
1. All allocations were fully utilised within the approved limits. No re-appropriation was
   required during the year.
2. The savings under SAL-01 arose due to one vacancy in the Forester cadre from October 2019
   to March 2020. The post was filled on 01/04/2020.
3. MNT-03 expenditure included the annual servicing of 14 waterhole pumps and purchase of
   spare parts for two pumps (Serial Nos. WP-07 and WP-09) which were replaced after the
   summer season.

Remarks (FY 2020-2021):
1. Due to the COVID-19 lockdown from March 2020, field patrols were reduced for two months
   (April and May 2020). However, essential anti-poaching patrols continued with minimal staff.
2. The savings under TRV-01 reflect the reduced fuel consumption during the lockdown period.
3. Camera trap maintenance was slightly lower than anticipated as only 12 units required
   battery replacement during the year. Two camera traps (Serial Nos. CT-1104 and CT-1108)
   were sent for repair to the workshop at Chandigarh and were returned in working condition
   after servicing in December 2020.

Remarks (FY 2021-2022):
1. The year saw resumption of full field patrolling after the COVID-19 restrictions were
   relaxed. Patrol kilometres increased by approximately 18% over the previous year.
2. TRV-01 savings were due to lower diesel prices prevailing during the second half of the
   year. The rate per litre remained below the budgeted estimate of ₹90/- for the months of
   November 2021 to February 2022.
3. MNT-02 expenditure included replacement of batteries in 18 camera traps. Three units
   (Serial Nos. CT-1201, CT-1205 and CT-1210) were found damaged beyond repair during the
   annual servicing and were condemned. Their disposal certificates are attached at
   Annexure-II.
4. MNT-03 covered the pre-monsoon servicing of all 14 waterhole pumps. One new pump
   (Serial No. WP-14) was installed at the Bhogpur waterhole in March 2022 to replace the
   old unit which had become non-functional due to motor burnout.

1. All heads of expenditure remained within the approved limits. No supplementary demand
   was made during the year.
2. The savings under SAL-01 arose due to one Ranger proceeding on earned leave for 45 days
   (July-August 2022). The leave salary was drawn at a lower rate, resulting in the savings.
3. MNT-02 included the purchase of 20 new lithium battery packs for camera traps. Five old
   units (Serial Nos. CT-1114, CT-1120, CT-1123, CT-1127 and CT-1131) were sent to the
   workshop at Chandigarh for re-casing and lens cleaning in September 2022 and were
   returned in working condition by November 2022.
4. A new waterhole was dug at the Rampur Beat in December 2022. The pump (Serial No.
   WP-15) was installed on 15/12/2022 and commissioned on the same day. The cost of
   installation was met from MNT-03.
